- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The university provides resources and support to alumni who start new businesses, including access to legal assistance, funding, and education on best practices.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Ohio State University has partnered with local economic development organizations to create initiatives that foster entrepreneurship and innovation, including an innovation center.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Overall, Ohio State University has used its alumni network to foster entrepreneurship, encourage innovation, and support economic growth.
- [USER] User requested specific examples of successful companies from Ohio State's alumni network.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Root Insurance, founded by alumni Alex Timm and Dan Manges in 2015, uses smartphone technology for customized car insurance.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Updox, founded by Michael Morgan, facilitates secure messaging and scheduling for medical providers.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Beam Dental, founded by Alex Curry and Dan Dykes, customizes dental care using data analytics and connected toothbrush technology.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] BoxCast, founded by Gordon Daily and Philippe von Borries in 2013, provides streaming services to various organizations.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Nexosis, founded by Ryan Sevey, offers a cloud-based platform for building predictive models and analyzing data.
- [USER] User expressed interest in resources or programs for female entrepreneurs in Ohio State's alumni network.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Women's Entrepreneurial Opportunity Project (WEOP) focuses on business development and financing for women-owned businesses.
